name: Dandeli
description: Nestled in the Western Ghats along the Kali River, Dandeli is renowned for white-water rafting, dense deciduous wildlife sanctuaries, and serene nature reserves.

name: Coorg
description: Also known as Kodagu, Coorg is a picturesque hill station famous for lush coffee plantations, misty valleys, stunning waterfalls, and rich Kodava culture.

name: Hampi
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site boasting grandiose 14th-century ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire amidst surreal boulder-strewn landscapes along the Tungabhadra River.

name: Goa
description: India's premier coastal haven featuring golden sun-kissed beaches, 16th-century Portuguese colonial architecture, UNESCO heritage churches, and vibrant local cuisine.
